GENERAL.TITLE: Basic Configuration
GENERAL.LOCALE_HELP: The default language for bot responses and dashboard content
GENERAL.THEME_HELP: You choose your dashboard's look under Themes.
GENERAL.SLASH_HELP: Commands like /help and the bot's context menus (right-click → Apps). Off means the bot unregisters them on this server and they disappear from Discord.
GENERAL.PRAEFIX_SWITCH_HELP: Commands with a prefix like !help. Off means the bot ignores all of them on this server, including mentions.

HELP.TITLE: Help & Tips
HELP.PREFIX_TEXT: Choose a unique prefix that doesn't conflict with other bots. Popular prefixes: !, ?, .
HELP.SLASH_TEXT: Slash commands are the modern alternative to text commands. They offer auto-completion and are more user-friendly.

LOESCHEN.TEXT: Deletes everything the bot stores about this server, then the bot leaves it.
LOESCHEN.PUNKT_PLUGINS: All plugins are switched off. Game servers are stopped and deleted.
LOESCHEN.PUNKT_DATEN: All settings, permissions, access and content of this server are deleted.
LOESCHEN.PUNKT_BOT: The bot leaves the server. If you invite it again, it starts empty.
LOESCHEN.PUNKT_MITGLIEDER: Your members' data on other servers stays untouched.
LOESCHEN.NUR_BESITZER: Only the server owner can do this.
LOESCHEN.MODAL_EINTIPPEN: Type the server name to confirm:
LOESCHEN.MODAL_DAUER: With game servers this can take a few minutes. Keep the page open.
LOESCHEN.FERTIG: The server has been deleted: {{n}} entries, {{plugins}} plugin(s) switched off. The bot has left it.
LOESCHEN.FERTIG_BOT_BLEIBT: The server has been deleted ({{n}} entries), but the bot did not leave it: {{grund}}. Please remove it in Discord yourself.

SETTINGS_OVERVIEW.PLUGIN_SETTINGS_TIP_TEXT: Check the left navigation - plugin-specific settings can be found under the respective plugin name in the submenus.

AUFBEWAHRUNG.TEXT: How long the bot keeps these entries. Older ones are deleted every night. Empty means: the default applies.
AUFBEWAHRUNG.BEGRENZT: {{tage}} days are set, the operator allows at most {{max}}. {{max}} apply.
AUFBEWAHRUNG.KEIN_RECHT: Only members with the permission {{recht}} can change this.
AUFBEWAHRUNG.LADEFEHLER: Could not load the retention periods: {{grund}}
AUFBEWAHRUNG.EREIGNISBUCH_SPAETESTENS: Domain events, at the latest (including stuck ones)

GESTALTUNG.TEXT: Colours, logo and banner of the messages the bot sends on this server. The dashboard and the server icon in Discord stay as they are.
GESTALTUNG.FARBEN_TEXT: Empty means default: each plugin then uses its own colour, and where it has none, the one suggested here. What you set applies to all plugins, including ones you switch on later.
GESTALTUNG.LOGO_TEXT: Small, in the footer of bot messages (giveaways, moderation messages to members).
GESTALTUNG.BANNER_TEXT: Large, below announcements such as a running giveaway.
GESTALTUNG.VORSCHAU_TEXT: This is how a message with the accent colour looks.
GESTALTUNG.ABWEICHEND_TEXT: These enabled plugins use their own colours instead of the ones here. You can change that on the plugin's page.
GESTALTUNG.NUR_LESEN_KONTROLLE: This is the control guild. Only the server owner changes the design here; you can only view it.
GESTALTUNG.NUR_LESEN_RECHT: Only members with the permission {{recht}} can change this.
GESTALTUNG.LADEFEHLER: The design could not be loaded: {{grund}}
GESTALTUNG.PLUGIN_TEXT: On: the plugin uses the colours under Settings → Design, and its own default where none is set there. Off: own colours for this plugin only.

VORLAGEN.FORM_HILFE: The same fields for every format. Components V2 is Discord's new layout: coloured bar, heading, image on the right, gallery and footer in one box.
VORLAGEN.TEXT_HILFE: Shown above the box. Mentions only ping the member the message is about.
VORLAGEN.VORSCHAUBILD_HILFE: Discord crops it to a square. Good for an avatar or logo.
VORLAGEN.BILD_HILFE: Address of an image, wide is fine. Placeholders like {gestaltung:banner} work.
VORLAGEN.PLATZHALTER_HILFE: Click to insert at the cursor.
VORLAGEN.VORSCHAU_HILFE: With you as the member and sample values. This is what the bot sends.
VORLAGEN.VORSCHAU_LEER: Empty: nothing is sent from this template.
VORLAGEN.UNBEKANNT: Unknown placeholders, they appear as typed: {{namen}}
